g.text: Lead-time uncertainty and disruption recovery affect service through different mechanisms

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned normal lead-time-demand distributions illustrate variability at a fixed reorder point. They are not measured supplier lead-time data; cycle-
service probability is not order fill rate. Rare disruptions may lie outside a normal model. Alternate supply, recovery time, visibility, and protected
capacity require separate service and cost evaluation.
